title: [C17T1] - Norbiton now and in the future
prompt: The maps below show an industrial area in the town of Norbiton, and planned future development of the site. Sumarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The maps compare the current industrial area of Norbiton with plans for its future development.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the most striking change is that the existing factories will be replaced by residential housing estates. Additionally, several new facilities including shops, a medical centre and a playground will be added to serve the new residential community.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking at the current layout, the industrial area is situated between the town to the west and farmland along the river to the north. The area features a key-shaped pattern, with a large roundabout as the head and factories extending out like the teeth of a key

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: According to the development plan, this industrial zone will be transformed into a residential area. The factories will be replaced by housing blocks, which will remain to be around the roundabout but will have a more scattered layout compared to the current factory pattern. The new plan also includes a second, smaller roundabout to the south. Furthermore, various amenities will be added, with shops and a medical centre positioned between the two roundabouts, and a playground established in the eastern section. The farmland to the north and the town to the west will remain unchanged.
